section: 1/1/2026Enacted by Chapter 182, 2025 General Session2025Reporting by payment settlement entity.A payment settlement entity that is required to file a return in accordance with 26 U.S.C. Sec. 6050W shall file a return containing the same information with the commission for each participating payee with an address in Utah:electronically;in a format approved by the commission; andwithin 30 days after the day on which the payment settlement entity is required to file a return with the Internal Revenue Service.
